tools.name: wp_get_posts
tools.description: List posts, pages or another post type, newest first. Returns ID, title, status, excerpt and link for each, without the full content. Filter by post_type, post_status, search text, author (user ID or slug) or a date range. Returns 10 items unless limit is set; page with offset or paged.

tools.name: wp_get_post
tools.description: Get one post or page by ID: title, content, status, dates and permalink. Set content_format to "prose" to return the text without block markup.

tools.name: wp_get_post_snapshot
tools.description: Get everything about one post by ID: all fields, custom fields, terms, featured image and author. Use include or exclude to limit the sections returned.

tools.name: wp_count_posts
tools.description: Count posts by status (published, draft, scheduled, pending, private, trash) for one post type. The default post type is post.

tools.name: wp_get_post_types
tools.description: List the public post types on the site with their key and label, such as post, page or product.

tools.name: wp_get_post_meta
tools.description: Get the custom fields of a post by ID. Pass key to read a single field; without it, all custom fields are returned.

tools.name: wp_get_comments
tools.description: List comments with their post, author, content, date and approval status. Filter by post_id, status, search text, user_id or author_email. Returns 10 unless limit is set. With type set to "note", it lists the editor notes on posts, where an approval status of 1 means the note thread is resolved.

tools.name: wp_get_taxonomies
tools.description: List the taxonomies available for a post type, such as categories and tags.

tools.name: wp_get_terms
tools.description: List the terms of a taxonomy (for example every category), optionally filtered by search text or parent term.

tools.name: wp_count_terms
tools.description: Count the terms in a taxonomy.

tools.name: wp_get_post_terms
tools.description: List the terms attached to a post, optionally for one taxonomy only.

tools.name: wp_get_media
tools.description: List items in the Media Library with their ID, title and URL. Filter by search text, uploader or date range. Returns 10 unless limit is set.

tools.name: wp_count_media
tools.description: Count the items in the Media Library, optionally within a date range.

tools.name: wp_list_block_patterns
tools.description: List the block patterns available on the site (ready-made layouts from WordPress, the theme and plugins), with name, title, categories and description. Filter by search text or category. Set include_content to true to also get each pattern's block markup, which can be placed in a post with Update po

tools.name: wp_create_post
tools.description: Create a post, page or item of another post type. post_title is required. post_content accepts HTML, blocks or Markdown. The status is draft unless post_status says otherwise, and the type is post unless post_type says otherwise. meta_input sets custom fields.

tools.name: wp_update_post
tools.description: Update an existing post by ID: title, content, excerpt, status, slug, date or custom fields. Pass the fields to change in fields and custom fields in meta_input. Set schedule_for to schedule publication. Passing post_category replaces all of the post's categories.

tools.name: wp_alter_post
tools.description: Find and replace text inside one field of a post (for example its content), without sending the whole content again. Supports regular expressions with regex set to true and modifiers in flags.

tools.name: wp_write_blocks
tools.description: Write block editor content to an existing post from a list of block specs. Types and fields: paragraph (content), heading (content, level 1-6), list (items, ordered), quote (content, citation), image (url, alt, caption), buttons (buttons: text, url), group (blocks), columns (columns: arrays of block

tools.name: wp_delete_post
tools.description: Move a post, page or item of another post type to the trash by ID. It can be restored from the trash in WordPress.

tools.name: wp_set_featured_image
tools.description: Set the featured image of a post to a Media Library item, or remove it when media_id is empty.

tools.name: wp_create_term
tools.description: Create a term in a taxonomy, such as a new category or tag, with an optional slug, description and parent.

tools.name: wp_update_term
tools.description: Update the name, slug, description or parent of an existing term.

tools.name: wp_add_post_terms
tools.description: Attach terms to a post. With append set to true they are added to the existing terms; otherwise they replace all terms of that taxonomy on the post.

tools.name: wp_upload_media
tools.description: Add a file to the Media Library, either from a public URL that WordPress downloads or from base64 content with a filename. Optional title, description and alt text.

tools.name: wp_update_media
tools.description: Update the title, caption, description or alt text of a Media Library item.

tools.name: wp_create_comment
tools.description: Add a comment to a post. post_id and comment_content are required; author name, email, URL and approval status are optional.

tools.name: wp_update_comment
tools.description: Update a comment by ID: its content or its approval status (approve, hold or mark as spam).

tools.name: wp_create_note
tools.description: Add an editor note to a block of a post (WordPress 6.9 or later), as shown in the editor's Notes panel. Locate the block with anchor_text (a short exact snippet of its text) or block_index, or reply to an existing note with parent_id.

tools.name: wp_update_note
tools.description: Edit the text of an editor note, or mark its thread as resolved or reopen it.

tools.name: wp_get_site_info
tools.description: Get the site's name, tagline, address and time zone.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: wp_get_posts, wp_get_post, wp_get_post_snapshot, wp_get_post_types, wp_get_post_meta, wp_get_comments, wp_get_taxonomies, wp_get_post_terms, wp_get_media, wp_list_block_patterns, wp_write_blocks · Private data: wp_count_posts, wp_upload_media · Public sink: wp_get_posts, wp_get_post, wp_get_post_snapshot, wp_count_posts, wp_get_post_types, wp_get_post_meta, wp_get_comments, wp_get_taxonomies, wp_get_post_terms, wp_list_block_patterns, wp_create_post, wp_update_post, wp_alter_post, wp_write_blocks, wp_delete_post, wp_set_featured_image, wp_add_post_terms, wp_upload_media, wp_create_comment, wp_create_note · Destructive: wp_delete_post, wp_set_featured_image.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: wp_get_posts, wp_get_post, wp_get_post_snapshot, wp_get_post_types, wp_get_post_meta, wp_get_comments, wp_get_taxonomies, wp_get_post_terms, wp_get_media, wp_list_block_patterns, wp_write_blocks · Private data: wp_count_posts, wp_upload_media · Public sink: wp_get_posts, wp_get_post, wp_get_post_snapshot, wp_count_posts, wp_get_post_types, wp_get_post_meta, wp_get_comments, wp_get_taxonomies, wp_get_post_terms, wp_list_block_patterns, wp_create_post, wp_update_post, wp_alter_post, wp_write_blocks, wp_delete_post, wp_set_featured_image, wp_add_post_terms, wp_upload_media, wp_create_comment, wp_create_note · Destructive: wp_delete_post, wp_set_featured_image

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
